```{r}

pca_recipe <- recipe(~., data = train_data) %>%

  update_role(id, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_scale(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_center(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_pca(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.80, num_comp = 10, id = "pca")

pca_recipe
```

# ── 2. Prep (estimate parameters on training data) ────────────────────────────
```{r}
pca_prepared <- prep(pca_recipe)
pca_prepared
```

# ── 3. Bake (apply to data) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
```{r}

train_baked <- bake(pca_prepared, new_data = NULL)        # transformed train set
test_baked  <- bake(pca_prepared, new_data = test_data)   # transformed test set
```

# ── 4. Variance explained ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```{r}
variance_tbl <- tidy(pca_prepared, id = "pca", type = "variance")
```

# Scree plot
```{r}

variance_tbl %>%
  filter(terms == "percent variance") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = component, y = value)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
  labs(
    title = "Scree Plot — Variance Explained per Component",
    x     = "Principal Component",
    y     = "% Variance Explained"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Cumulative variance plot
```{r}

variance_tbl %>%
  filter(terms == "cumulative percent variance") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = component, y = value)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Variance Explained",
    x     = "Principal Component",
    y     = "Cumulative % Variance",
    caption = "Red dashed line = 80% threshold"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


loadings_tbl <- tidy(pca_prepared, id = "pca", type = "coef")

```

```{r}
# Top 10 contributors to PC1 and PC2
loadings_tbl %>%
  filter(component %in% c("PC1", "PC2", 'PC3', 'PC4', 'PC5')) %>%
  group_by(component) %>%
  slice_max(abs(value), n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(terms = reorder_within(terms, abs(value), component)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = terms, y = value, fill = value > 0)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~component, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tomato", "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Variable Loadings — PC1 - PC5",
    x     = 'variable',
    y     = "Loading"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 6. PC scores scatter plot (PC1 vs PC2)
```{r}

ggplot(train_baked, aes(x = 'PC1', y = 'PC2')) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# PC Regression
```{r}
logistic_model <- logistic_reg() %>%
        set_engine("glm") %>%
        set_mode("classification") 
```


```{r}
pca_reg_recipe <- recipe(ever_depression ~., data = train_data) %>%
  update_role(id, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_scale(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_center(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_pca(all_numeric_predictors(), id = "pca_id")

pca_reg_recipe
```

```{r}
bmi_workflow <- 
        workflow() %>%
        add_model(logistic_model) %>% 
        add_recipe(pca_reg_recipe)

bmi_workflow
```

```{r}
bmi_fit <- 
  bmi_workflow %>% 
  fit(data = train_data)
```

```{r}
bmi_fit_extract <- bmi_fit %>% 
                    extract_fit_parsnip() %>% 
                    tidy()
bmi_fit_extract
```

```{r}
bmi_predicted <- augment(bmi_fit, test_data)

ggplot(bmi_predicted, aes(x = ever_depression, y = .pred_class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Measured BMI", y = "Predicted BMI") +
  theme_minimal()
```
